summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on enhancing integration with Spark, particularly with the upcoming Spark 4.1 version. Key topics include addressing the size of the metadata.json file, proposals for adding a 'Tags' field in Iceberg V4, and improvements to the Java REST client for better compatibility.
highlights: Iceberg-Spark integration work and async reader improvements
Proposal to add 'Tags' field in Iceberg V4 metadata
Java REST client URL encoding compatibility issues
